items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: they had transcribed Bunny Berigan’s original chorus on “Marie” for the entire trumpet section.

ctx.x: In the car. Do you remember that? Any significance to that?

I remember that what they had done was — the hit song that he had at that time — no I mean Tommy Dorsey had a couple of hits. One was “Song of India” and the other was “Marie.” But what they had done was they had transcribed Bunny Berigan’s original chorus on “Marie” for the entire trumpet section. And man, when Charlie Shavers hit that night with that, I’m not sure that he had the lead part or not — I wouldn’t be surprised but what he didn’t — but when he did it just blew the place apart. Man, you know, like…
